rationale: Bump lr 1e-4 -> 2e-4. Iter-11/12 suggested model LR-limited. Test 2x learning rate at constant schedule.
advice_for_others: NEAR-FLAT DISCARD: hr=0.5777 vs 0.5807 (-0.30pp), SSIM up (+0.0071) but headroom slightly down. Conclusion: model is NEITHER LR-limited NOR LR-saturated; lr in 1e-4 to 2e-4 range gives near-identical headroom. LR is not the bottleneck. Lesson: stop iterating on LR/schedule for this baseline - look at ARCHITECTURE or loss formulation instead.
